programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Tras tomar un taxi, Belinda, una joven modelo, es asesinada. El chofer es el principal sospechoso; sin embargo, el culpable es alguien más.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven intenta no darle importancia al problema de alcoholismo y violencia de su madre, pero termina aceptando la ayuda de sus amigas y de su novio para salvar la vida de su mamá y la relación con ella.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Daniel es un joven de preparatoria que trata a sus profesores con la punta del pie, hasta que un día mata accidentalmente a la profesora Salazar junto con su amigo Sergio.
programme.sub-title: El cobarde y el ladrón van siempre con precaución

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Amanda sufre ataques de pánico tras el abuso sexual de su suegro, quien es muy amigo de su familia. Cuando ella les cuenta lo sucedido a sus hermanos, no le creen y su hermana corre peligro de sufrir lo mismo.
programme.sub-title: Se dice el pecado, mas no el pecador

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Iñaki perdió a sus padres en un accidente aéreo. El quiere ser DJ, pero debe lidiar con la disciplina de su abuelo.
programme.sub-title: Quien de tu mal no te advierte, mal te quiere

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sol y Pilar planean incluir a Celina en su nuevo grupo de popularidad. Lupita no quiere que Lola descubra que salió con Santos. Diego golpea a Santos. Sol termina su relación con Diego, y Agustina con Giovanni. José amenaza con golpear a Raquel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía ve un video y se da cuenta de que Celina le ha estado mintiendo para salir con un chico. León le advierte a Diego que tiene que ganar las elecciones sí o sí, o lo castigará.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía cuestiona a Celina por no decirle que anda con Alex. Es el día de la votación y gana Diego, pero José está segura de que hicieron fraude. Roberta trata de quejarse, pero la castigan y Reverte la consuela, mientras Alma los ve de manera extraña.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel está muy enfermo y Mía lo cuida a pesar de todos los problemas que tienen. Diego engaña a Roberta para llevarla a su departamento y hablar con ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Romina se queda a cuidar a Miguel. Gandía pide a Diego, Giovanni y Tomás que encuentren al ladrón de su pluma. Miguel va a la escuela y Gastón lo corre, así que se esconde. Teo va al desfile de las Top Girls y se pelea con José.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego reconoce ante todos que hizo trampa para ganar la Presidencia. Miguel logra meterse a la escuela y habla con Mía. Roberta provoca que se le caiga la falda a Raquel. Mía se presenta en el desfile, modelando y regalando ropa de la marca Colucci.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se reconcilian y le dice que siempre soñó con volver a estar así con él. Rocco le insinúa a Giovanni que ante la careta de machito que tiene, se esconde un gay. Roberta le dice a José que se está haciendo daño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se reconcilia con Vico y Celina. Vico enfrenta a Pilar porque se entera de que ella causó su separación de Giovanni. Miguel regresa a la escuela y todos descubren que volvió con Mía. Tomás y Giovanni creen que Roberta y Diego andan a escondidas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma sigue desconfiando de Reverte. Santos le dice a Teo que si ya no se siente bien termine con José. Roberta se entera de que Diego está diciendo que pasaron la noche juntos. Alma vuelve a ver a Octavio abrazando a Roberta y le exige que la suelte.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma explota ante Reverte y le pide a Roberta tener cuidado con él. Lola entra al cuarto de Santos en la noche y lo besa, pero él la confunde con Lupita. Gastón descubre a Mía y a Miguel besándose.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le explica a Mía que Gastón lo obligó a hacer un trabajo con Romina. Lupita le dice a Santos que la que lo besó fue Lola. Roberta le encarga a Rocco que la grabe cuando se le declare a Diego. Teo le pide a Jose que lo acompañe a ver a su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita recrimina a Santos por rechazar a Lola y decirle que era por ella. Teo no resiste ver a su mamá mal y sale corriendo. Lola le dice a Lupita que la detesta. Roberta exhibe un video para demostrar que Diego y ella no tienen relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel no acepta que Franco le pague la colegiatura para que deje de ser becado; Teo le reclama a José por decirle a Gastón que tiene asma para que no lo aceptara en el equipo de fútbol; Roberta se disculpa con Diego por lo del video.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta insulta a Iñaki por inventar que Diego hablaba mal de ella. Teo le da clases de equitación a Raquel; León rechaza tajantemente la idea de Diego de dedicarse a la música. Martín Octavio quiere platicar con Roberta sobre su cuadro.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El profesor Reverte lleva a Roberta a conocer niños de la calle y así aprenda a valorar lo que tienen en la vida. Alma le reclama a Reverte por haberse llevado a Roberta sin permiso. Iñaki se vuelve el técnico de RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le asegura a Mía que Sol es una buena persona. León lleva a cabo sus planes para lograr que Diego abandone la banda. Alma descubre que Octavio tiene un hermano gemelo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego convoca a sus compañeras para que hagan pruebas y así encontrar a las suplentes de Roberta y Lupita, debido a que ellas decidieron dejar el grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico decide hacer la audición para ser la nueva vocalista de la banda. Lola le confiesa a Roberta el gran amor que siente por Santos. Mía logra que Sol no se quede en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján sufre al saber que Teo decidió terminar su relación. Diego se encela al ver a Roberta besándose con Nikki. Alma sospecha que Octavio no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola sufre al saber que Santos jamás se enamorará de ella. Diego se molesta al saber que Roberta le robó sus canciones. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para hacerle la vida imposible a Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni tiene muchos problemas para escribir una carta dirigida al director. Jose se enoja con Roberta porque no le contó que Teo la engaña con Raquel. Roberta planea destruir Rebelde. Mía logra que Selina le confiese su plan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego y sus amigos hacen un plan para que Roberta vaya a su departamento. Sol vierte pegamento en el cabello de Mía. Roberta rechaza a Iñaki porque ella no quiere tener novio. Mía les muestra a sus amigas que recuperó su cama en el dormitorio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján quiere renunciar a la escuela. Alma se preocupa cuando encuentra una carta de Roberta donde le dice que se irá por unos días, pero Roberta ha decidido irse de manera definitiva. Roberta se deprime al recordar su solitaria infancia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía contrata a un estilista para que le quite el pegamento que Sol le echó en el cabello. Diego le confiesa a Iñaki que pasó la noche con Roberta. Mía cobra venganza y le juega una broma pesada a Sol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual trata de arruinar el concierto de RBD en beneficio de los niños de la calle. Roberta se las ingenia para dejar la escuela incomunicada y estropear las intenciones de Pascual. Roberta no quiere contarle a su mamá que Diego la secuestró.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta es descubierta en la dirección por Pascual. Jose descubre que Roberta le escribió a su tutor. Alma no está segura quien es el padre de Roberta. Roberta discute con Luján porque quiere dejar el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse a París con su papá, pues no quiere dejar a Miguel y a la banda. Miguel trata de convencer a Mía de viajar con su padre. El padre de Mía habla con Pascual para que Alma deje de darle clases a su hija.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le hace creer a Pascual que él podría ser el padre de Roberta. Pascual encuentra el celular que estaba desaparecido. Mia decide ayudar a Roberta y se juntan todos los miembros originales de la banda para el concierto.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: RBD tiene un concierto donde deben demostrar su talento. Todos los alumnos de la Elite Way participan en el concierto lo que los pone nerviosos, contentos y entusiasmados. Alma sigue pensando que Pascual puede ser el padre de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León lleva a la policía al concierto de RBD para impedir que su hijo cante y Roberta presenta a León como patrocinador de su presentación.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se despide de sus amigas, pues debe viajar con su padre, ella les pide que le entreguen una carta a Miguel. Giovanni busca a Victoria para preguntarle si sale con Rocco. Roberta comienza a llevarse bien con el nuevo novio de su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sabrina recrimina a Miguel porque no aceptó cantar para una niña enferma. Diego culpa a Roberta de todo lo que le pasa. Diego y Tomás le piden trabajo al papá de Giovanni en su carnicería. Vico descubre que su papá se gasta su dinero en apuestas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Iñaki está emocionado por la carta que le dio Roberta. Vico está muy triste y Rocco llega a consolarla. Teo habla con José para decirle que su mamá quiere verla a ella, pero ella no quiere. Celina está muy nerviosa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual va a buscar a su hija y los persigue por toda la casa. Miguel va al hospital a buscar a Sabrina, donde ella está muy bien y hace labor social. Giovanni pide ayuda a su mamá, pero cuando llega, se avergüenza de ella mientras Diego la defiende.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le propone a Martín trabajar como su bailarín y corista. Mía y Miguel se extrañan mutuamente. Pascual habla con Alma sobre la reunión de los alumnos en la que estaban desnudos, pero él tiene problemas con Galia porque se pone celosa de Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico le pide a Celina más tiempo para poder pagarle el dinero que le debe. Rocco les pregunta a Diego y a Giovanni si saben algo del papá de Vico. Una mujer llega de manera abrupta a ver a León para exigirle por su hijo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La mamá de Diego regresa para verlo, pero León no se lo permite. Vico empeña la pulsera de la amistad que le regaló Mía para conseguir dinero y dárselo a su papá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico le inventa a Rocco que es amante de un anciano y ella es la que le da dinero; Sol se enoja al no ser elegida como modelo para una campaña; Alma acusa a Reverte de homosexual por acosar a Iñaki; Diego amenaza con matar a la profesora Julia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía le aclara a Alma que Reverte no es homosexual. Alma le confirma a Gandía que Roberta no es su hija. León amenaza a Mabel con lastimar a Diego si se atreve a buscarlo. Diego le exige a Roberta que le diga cómo supo del enema que le hicieron.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El padre de Sabrina quiere hacerles una entrevista al grupo RBD, lo que pone a los chicos muy felices, pero ella lo que busca es acercarse más a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego se enoja con Tomás al descubrir que fue él quien dijo lo de su enema. Celina recrimina a Sol por alejar a Alan de ella. Diego confiesa que extraña a su mamá. Teo golpea a Gastón por maltratar a Jose. Rocco cree que Vico consume drogas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Las chicas están en una reunión con la maestra Fátima, la cual dice que ella está para dirigirlas en su equipo de porristas sustituyendo a Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta hace un plan para que José tenga una cita en el departamento de Diego y demostrarle a Teo que ya lo olvidó. Mía discute con su padre y él le dice que cambie esa cara pesada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sol le dice a Ana que si no ha visto a Celina, aprovecha también para decirle que ella está para servir en la escuela entonces le pide una orden de alimentos larga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El papá de Rocco por fin conoce a su novia Victoria y le dice que se ve mejor sin sus lentes obscuros, ya que es de mala educación tenerlos puestos y más si no hay rayos del sol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina gana un concurso en el que participa en la radio y Pascual le dice que hay un tipo que pregunta por ella y resulta que es el cantante Ricardo Montaner.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Victoria llora en un pasillo de la escuela, a lo lejos. Mía se da cuenta y le dice que le cuente qué es lo que le pasa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta entra al examen de Diego para distraer a la maestra de Literatura y la maestra le dice que es mentira lo que dice.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se molesta con Miguel porque no usa el traje que le regaló y prefiere ir con una chamarra y jeans, sin importarle que van a la ópera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón enfrenta a Roberta debido a que él, con el pretexto de buscar a José, irrumpe en su dormitorio a horas inapropiadas con violencia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Todos los chicos le donan ropa a Sabrina para los niños del hospital, Jack emocionado le dice a Miguel que ya quiere volver a ver a Sabrina, el dinero que recauden es para medicinas de los niños del hospital.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía les cuenta a Celina y Vico que estuvo a punto de entregarse con Miguel, pero que Gastón casi los descubre. León sorprende a Diego y sus amigos intentando salir del colegio. Vico tiene dificultades con su padre. Jose sufre al ver a Raquel y Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego y Giovanni le dicen a Tomás que Sol lo engaña, pero Sol le dice que sus amigos los quieren separar porque están interesados en ella y Tomás la perdona.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los alumnos hacen una protesta, pues con el entrenamiento de fútbol no tienen tiempo de estudiar. Roberta propone entrenar los fines de semana y todos se ponen en su contra.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Licha interroga a Adolfo y por fin se entera de dónde viene el novio de La Nena. Mientras tanto Martina hace una obra de caridad, convirtiendo a Tecla en una chica agradable.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: When you feel surrounded by pressure and fear, it's easy to lose perspective. But what if God's already provided the help you've been praying for? Keep it in context: the battle isn't proof you're losing, it's evidence that you're carrying something worth fighting for.

programme.title: Now Playing: Worship From Elevation
programme.desc: The official video for So Be It by Elevation Worship featuring Tiffany Hudson and Chris Brown.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: We all go through times when we're looking ahead, and our future looks uncertain. We want clarity, but instead, God gives us the courage to move forward in faith. It's in these moments we learn not to be driven by what's easy but to be pulled forward by purpose.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: When you've been hurt, it can be hard to keep hoping. But God wants to lift the weight you've been carrying today. Learn from the life of Israel (Jacob), how God will give you a strategy to unburden your heart and move forward.
programme.sub-title: The Lord Will Lighten Your Load

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Stressed, insecure, and stuck - that's how Moses felt, too. But that wasn't the end of his story, and it's not yours, either. It's just the middle. There's hope past this chapter, and it's found by shifting your focus back to God.

programme.title: Elevation Church Live
programme.desc: Welcome to Elevation Church. See what God can do through you.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: We all find ourselves in seasons when we feel like we don't have what it takes, and we don't know what to do. But don't be afraid or discouraged, because God isn't late - He's working according to His timing. Don't lose hope, and don't give up.
programme.sub-title: All You've Got To Do Is Don't

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: We often ask God to do what we want, but faith starts with doing what He says. When you trust God as your good Father and follow His prompting, even small steps can unlock something big.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: If you've been feeling pulled in every direction, it might be time to pivot. God isn't asking you to do everything - He's asking you to stay close to Him.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Don't be so confused about the noise around you that you can't hear the God who made you. When you're faced with a struggle you didn't see coming, remember that Jesus is already praying for you, and His prayer is stronger than any attack.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: God, can You get me out of this? It's a prayer we've all prayed. But what if God's answer isn't escape, but endurance? What if His rescue comes one day at a time? This message will help you recognize God's faithful provision in every season and learn how to trust His hand as He leads you through.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Ever feel like there are too many voices telling you what to do and who to be? The enemy whispers fear, doubt, and distraction, but God's whisper brings peace, purpose, and direction. programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Is your faith being tested? If you've been waiting on the details of what God has next, remember that God doesn't give a test without a lesson first, so if He's calling you to let go of something, you can trust He's already provided you with what you'll need to take that step.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: If you're looking at what's next and feeling nervous, remember this: What God has done in your life is only the foundation, not the finish line. He's a creative God, still at work in ways you're not expecting. Let go of your plan, so God can show you His purpose.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Some things look stupid to the world… until God uses them to change everything. If you've been holding back because you need everything to make sense, this will call you to trust what God promised and practice gratitude in the hard place.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: The enemy loves to trap you in the same old lies: It's not enough, and You're not loved. But God's truth breaks the cycle. When you change what you say, you change what you see, and His presence opens a new loop of peace and hope.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Are you standing over a situation that's too big for you? If you feel like your hope, logic, and options are at a dead end, pay attention because this might be your God moment.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: This sermon is for someone who has been hearing the same lies from the enemy for so long that you've started to believe them. But you are not your issue. programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: A crime lord plots to take control of New York's underground drug economy and distribute the profits to the poor.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecter and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: The Lieutenant (Harvey Keitel) is a corrupt cop steeped in gambling debt who exploits his authority to sexually harass teenage girls, embezzle money and abuse drugs. His troubles come to a head when a mob lackey delivers an ultimatum: pay off his debt, or else. His fate appears sealed. But when The Lieutenant learns that a $50,000 reward is being offered to whoever catches a pair of thugs who raped a nun (Frankie Thorn), he jumps at the opportunity, hoping that he can still redeem himself.

programme.title: Light Sleeper
programme.desc: A Manhattan drug dealer with a wealthy clientele, John LeTour reevaluates both his trade and his life after discovering that his supplier, Ann, is planning on quitting the business. When John runs into his old flame Marianne, he sees reconnecting with her as a way to change for the better, but she is reluctant to rekindle the romance. Complicating John's life further is a series of drug-related murders that has the police pegging him as a suspect.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: The Last Stand
programme.desc: Once a narcotics officer in the LAPD, Ray Owens settles into a peaceful life as sheriff of Sommerton Junction, a quiet border town. Ray is at first reluctant to get involved, but he soon finds he must rally his team and take matters into his own hands.

The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: El hombre del puente
programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: El Pichichi del Barrio
programme.desc: El Pichichi es el entrenador de un equipo de fútbol femenino patrocinado por un narcotraficante ambicioso.

programme.title: Cuentos colorados
programme.desc: Las aventuras ocurren en una casa de citas muy lujosa, pero el dueño no lo confiesa su profesión a su tía.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: Asesinos de la Montaña
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un matrimonio arreglado para su hija, pero ella se marcha y vuelve con un hombre, mas se arrepiente.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon, his wife Liz, and Liv Annacone cook Big Rigs rigatoni with spicy Italian sausage and vodka sauce in their front yard. Michael demonstrates his "cheater sauce" approach using pre-seasoned sausage, tomato paste, cream, and vodka that comes together in under 30 minutes without needing a knife. The hosts discuss pasta cooking techniques, the importance of finishing pasta in sauce rather than plating separately, proper seasoning of pasta water, and using quality ingredients like whole Parmigiano-Reggiano. They pair the dish with Lambrusco, an Italian sparkling red wine, exploring its versatility with various cuisines and its ability to cut through rich, spicy flavors.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon demonstrates how to properly grill skirt steak, explaining the differences between skirt and flank cuts and the importance of cutting against the grain. He seasons the thin-cut steak with salt, pepper, soy sauce, and Dijon mustard for extra caramelization, cooking it quickly over high heat to achieve a perfect medium-rare. Meanwhile, Liz Symon builds a vibrant chopped salad featuring romaine and butter lettuce, cherry tomatoes, red onion, fresh dill, and blue cheese, dressed with a homemade red wine vinaigrette shaken in a mason jar. Liz also creates a Martinez cocktail—a stirred drink combining vodka, sweet vermouth, bitters, and amarena cherry juice—which she describes as a cross between a vodka martini and an old fashioned. The hosts discuss lettuce varieties, proper salad dressing ratios, and why steak pairs better with textured, acidic sides than with starches.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this episode of Simply Symons, Michael Symon grills single-bone pork chops over hot coals and pairs them with a flavorful broth-based sauce of sautéed banana peppers, sweet red peppers, garlic, red onion, chili flakes, Dijon mustard, and herbs. Liz Symon demonstrates how to make a bourbon maple lemonade cocktail with fresh lemon juice and maple simple syrup, ideal for summer entertaining. Co-host Liv Annacone joins the banter as the hosts discuss seasoning techniques, grill setup, and the importance of honest communication in relationships while preparing and finishing this vibrant, quick-cooking American-Italian dish.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, hosts Michael and Liz Symon welcome Liv Annacone to their Venice bay home where they celebrate summer clamming season. Michael prepares a classic steamed clam dish featuring pancetta, garlic, shallots, chili flakes, and white wine, served with grilled sourdough bread rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato. Liz creates a French gimlet cocktail using vodka, fresh lime juice, and elderflower liqueur instead of traditional simple syrup. The hosts discuss clamming techniques, bread storage debate, herb preparation, and garlic preferences while encouraging Liv to expand her seafood palate with the briny, flavorful dish.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon makes a hearty frittata using leftover roasted potatoes, fresh spinach, feta cheese, shallots, and garlic, seasoned with rosemary and cooked in a cast iron skillet over a grill. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares an indulgent chocolate-orange brunch cocktail featuring bourbon, coffee liqueur, Grand Marnier, and cold brew coffee, topped with homemade whipped cream infused with vanilla and orange bitters. The episode explores egg quality and sourcing, frittata versatility as a dish for any meal, and creative topping options. Liv Annacone joins the conversation about college memories and various accompaniments. The frittata serves as a practical solution for using refrigerator leftovers and entertaining groups.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Simply Symons hosts an upscale backyard tailgate featuring two main components: Michael's beer-poached bratwurst with kimchi, served on buttered and grilled hard rolls with pop mustard and optional Kewpie mayo, and Liz's inventive bourbon sour cocktail made with sage-infused bourbon, Benedictine, brown sugar simple syrup, lemon juice, lemon curd, and egg whites shaken in a mason jar. The hosts discuss bread storage methods, the classification of hot dogs as sandwiches, and bratwurst preparation techniques including splitting the sausage for better presentation. Liv joins in tasting both dishes, initially skeptical of kimchi but warming to the combination with Kewpie mayo and the bourbon sour despite typically avoiding bourbon.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone prepare a summer feast featuring crispy panko chicken cutlets cooked in cast iron and served over bitter radicchio greens, fresh basil, and parsley with a light garlic-shallot vinaigrette. The team discusses cooking techniques including the FEB breading method, anchovy options, and proper chicken temperature. Liz creates an elderflower rosé spritz using frozen Harry's berries as ice cubes to prevent dilution. The dish comes together quickly and elegantly, demonstrating how simple ingredients and proper technique create restaurant-quality results at home.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone explore two iconic dishes with creative twists. Michael demonstrates his take on the New York bodega classic chopped cheese—ground beef mixed with caramelized onions, melted provolone, and pepperoncini on a hoagie roll with Kewpie mayo. He explains the technique of creating a chopped smash burger texture and offers tips for cooking it indoors or outdoors. Meanwhile, Liz prepares a kid-friendly cherry float by making homemade cherry syrup from frozen cherries, lemon juice, and sugar, then serving it over vanilla ice cream with optional alcohol additions like amaretto or bourbon. The hosts discuss ingredient variations, cooking methods, and how these simple, budget-friendly dishes are perfect for summer entertaining.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone cook together in the backyard on Simply Symons. Michael demonstrates how to grill pork tenderloin using a quick marinade of soy sauce, yellow mustard, maple syrup, and olive oil, then creates a fresh peach salad with thinly sliced raw onions, lime juice, sherry vinegar, toasted almonds, spicy mustard, and peppery arugula. Liz makes a peach mule cocktail using vodka, peach marmalade, lime juice, and ginger beer. The hosts discuss meat preparation techniques, seasonal fruit selection, and entertaining with batch cocktails.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone cook outdoors in this episode of Simply Symons. Michael grills a flank steak seasoned with kosher salt and olive oil, achieving a perfect medium doneness with beautiful char. He demonstrates a creative technique using a mesh strainer to smoke grape tomatoes over the grill, infusing them with smoky flavor and blistering their skins. Michael prepares a vibrant chimichurri sauce featuring garlic, flat-leaf parsley, mint, dried oregano bloomed in hot water, and a chili blend of Urfa, Aleppo, and Calabrian peppers. The dish is finished with crumbled blue cheese and extra virgin olive oil. Meanwhile, Liz crafts a Rosita cocktail, a tequila-based drink made with reposado tequila, sweet vermouth, Lillet, and Campari, garnished with a citrus twist. The hosts discuss beef quality, the importance of intermuscular fat, cutting flank steak against the grain, and the classic pairing of beef with blue cheese.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this backyard episode, Michael Symon and Liz Symon share their favorite things with guest Liv Annacone. Michael grills a perfectly juicy half chicken topped with a balanced caramel fish sauce glaze featuring chili crunch, shallots, lime juice, and soy sauce. Meanwhile, Liz crafts a rye orange coffee cocktail using Willett rye, Amaro Nonino, cold brew, and aranciata orange soda, garnished with an orange twist. The episode covers cooking techniques for crispy-skinned chicken, the importance of proper temperature control, and the versatility of the fish sauce caramel glaze. Michael demonstrates the glaze-and-sear method for achieving perfectly crackling skin, and both dishes showcase balanced flavor profiles combining sweet, savory, umami, and heat.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Simply Symons hosts an at-home date night episode featuring grilled whole branzino prepared Greek-style with oregano, lemon, olive oil, and fresh dill. Michael Symon demonstrates grilling techniques using a fish basket, filleting methods, and the benefits of cooking whole fish on the bone for moisture and flavor. Liz Symon creates a grapefruit rose sour cocktail using grapefruit-rose infused vodka, lemon juice, egg white, and Cointreau. The hosts discuss cost-saving benefits of preparing restaurant-quality dishes at home, proper fish selection options, and the simplicity of Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. Guest Liv Annacone participates throughout, while the hosts playfully banter about fish preparation and date night logistics.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon creates a quick and inexpensive curry mussels dish featuring full-fat coconut milk, lime juice, cilantro, and fresh jalapenos, served with charred sourdough bread for soaking up the aromatic broth. Meanwhile, Liz Symon whips up fresas con crema, a deceptively simple dessert made with sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, and crème fraîche, topped with fresh strawberries and finished with a hint of lime zest and mint. Host Liv Annacone tastes both dishes, and the hosts discuss the ease and elegance of preparing gourmet meals in minutes with minimal ingredients and prep work.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. He advocates strongly for using whole fresh garlic rather than pre-peeled or jarred varieties, explaining how commercial processing compromises flavor. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Chewed Up

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic’s luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic’s first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4–6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846–1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman’s last meal (c. 3,359–3,105 BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi’s clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents—smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns—Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919’s first commercial meal to aviation’s Golden Age (1950s–70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland’s rigid food hierarchy—peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat—and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal’s gluttony.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job—cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer’s 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they’re as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that’s needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you’re in Amalfi.

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband’s recipe Guy’s Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you’ll want seconds, thirds, fourths!

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to “Yay!” And they’re not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to “Yum!”

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teams up with Executive Chef David Crinieri to wow her cooking students by exploring the world of perfect pestos. Chef David leads off with a delicate Watercress Pesto tossed with Fresh Spinach Linguine and topped with an Artichoke Crudo. Mary Ann’s up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one—or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini

programme.title: Landslide: A Portrait of President Herbert Hoover
programme.desc: Herbert Hoover was a politician and a humanitarian whose legacy has been largely defined by the Great Depression. When he was elected president in a landslide victory in 1928, Hoover had never before held public office. Even so, his humanitarian work and career as a mining engineer, businessman and U.S. Secretary of Commerce carried him to a win. When the stock market crashed on October 29, 1929, Hoovers agenda was derailed by the worsening economic crisis. Despite various efforts to pull the nation out of depression, Hoovers unsuccessful attempts led to his sound defeat by Franklin Roosevelt just four years after his landslide victory. LANDSLIDE looks at the life of the controversial figure through interviews with notable historians and Hoover scholars.The program explores the facts and fictions behind the presidency of Herbert Hoover including The Great Depression and the role of the Federal Reserve. Hoovers early life in Iowa and abroad, the international experiences that led to his decision to run for office, his presidency and political philosophy, and the lasting impacts of his policy decisions during and after the depression are revealed. Through interviews with notable scholars such as David Kennedy, Amity Shlaes, Robert Reich, Tim Egan and Timothy Walch, this biography sheds new light on Hoovers difficult tenure and enduring legacy.

programme.title: Elvis and the USS Arizona
programme.desc: ELVIS AND THE USS ARIZONA tells the surprising story of how one of music's biggest icons helped to establish a USS Arizona memorial in Pearl Harbor.In the late 1950s, the USS Arizona Memorial Commission was struggling to raise money for a permanent memorial to honor the 1,177 crewmen who lost their lives aboard the battleship on December 7, 1941. After a successful fundraising push, momentum had slowed, and though construction on the approved design was underway, only half of the necessary funds had been raised.Recently honorably discharged from the U.S. Army and headed to Hawaii to begin filming Blue Hawaii, Elvis was presented by his manager to the idea of a benefit concert to support the memorial fund. He agreed without hesitation and on March 25, 1961, performed to a sold-out crowd at the Bloch arena on the naval base. Elvis concert would draw public attention to the plight and help galvanize efforts to finish the USS Arizona Memorial as it still stands today.

programme.title: Doolittle's Raiders: A Final Toast
programme.desc: The bottle of 1896 Hennessy Cognac was uncorked in front of hundreds of people. The surviving World War II veterans from one of historys greatest military missions were about to raise their silver goblets one last time ending a decades long tradition. It was time for the veterans to hold this final toast. They could wait no longer. Their numbers had dwindled to just a few. Many of the names of the 80 flyers who took part in the April 18, 1942 raid on Japan may not be familiar to most, but collectively they will always be known in history as the Doolittle Tokyo Raiders. Long ago these American flyers, aboard 16 B-25 bombers, had accomplished a daring mission that changed the morale of an entire nation. The aviators, led by famed commander Lt. Col. James Harold Doolittle, had taken the fight directly to the enemy for the first time in the war and delivered retribution for Japans sneak attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.

programme.title: Survivors of Malmedy: December 1944
programme.desc: SURVIVORS OF MALMEDY: DECEMBER 1944 tells the story of the World War II massacre of 84 American soldiers in Belgium during the opening days of the famous Battle of the Bulge.On December 17, 1944, after a short battle, more than 130 American GIs were taken prisoner just outside the Belgian town of Malmedy and herded into a field by an infamous German SS division led by one of the Nazi's most brutal commanders. The unarmed American prisoners were gunned down. Those still alive after the initial shooting in the brutal cold were killed by SS soldiers ordered into the field to execute any Americans still breathing. Some American soldiers played dead. Some ran. Some escaped to nearby houses. In the end, more than 50 Americans did escape the infamous Malmedy Massacre. Today, just a handful of soldiers remain.Weaving interviews with the few remaining survivors of the massacre with archival footage, and drone video shot in the Malmedy area and in the field where the infamous event occurred, the emotional and powerful SURVIVORS OF MALMEDY chronicles what became known as the largest single mass murder of American troops in World War II.

programme.title: The U-Boat and the Rocket
programme.desc: During World War II, the Germans had two deadly weapons in their arsenal the U-Boat and the V-2 rocket. The new documentary film THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET chronicles the wartime development of the V-2, which was the worlds first long-range guided ballistic missile, and Germanys attempts to deploy the weapon from its formidable U-Boats. Woven into this history is the tale of two German brothers who were each involved with the secretive mission for the Third Reich. Ernst Steinhoff was Wernher von Brauns assistant for guidance control on the V-2, and Friedrich Steinhoff was a U-boat captain-lieutenant. Rich with archival footage and interviews with historical experts, THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET recounts Germany's creation and testing of the rocket, and the story of the two brothers who ultimately met different fates at the end of the war. Ernst and Wernher von Braun were invited to come to the U.S. in Operation Paperclip, the secret United States intelligence program which employed German scientists after Germany surrendered. Both Ernst and von Braun were subsequently inaugurated in the International Space Hall of Fame as pioneers of the Space Age. For Friedrich, the outcome was very different. After surrendering his U-Boat, he was brutally interrogated by US naval agents and allegedly committed suicide in a New England prison.

programme.title: Hitler's Mein Kampf: Prelude to the Holocaust
programme.desc: While in prison for his role in the failed Beer Hall Putsch of 1923, Adolf Hitler composed the first of his two-volume work, Mein Kampf. In it, he revealed his desire to lead Germany to greater heights through a utopian vision of an Aryan nation free of Jews and encompassing greater territory through colonialism. When Hitler became Chancellor in 1933 and then Fhrer in 1934, his vision evolved into a dystopian nightmare with the onset of WWII and the Shoah/Holocaust. HITLERS MEIN KAMPF: PRELUDE TO THE HOLOCAUST explores whether Hitlers hateful racial beliefs set down in his manifesto laid the groundwork for the genocidal actions of the Third Reich.Through interviews with historians and experts, the film gives insights into the origins and evolution of Hitlers mindset about Germany and his image of leadership. Hitlers potent mix of ideas included Eugenics, 19th century racial studies and Social Darwinism, as well as political notions from Volk Ideologies. Scholars also reveal how Hitler used law, violence and propaganda to control the Volk along the genocidal path to the annihilation of the Jews, the disabled, and so-called half-breeds. Holocaust educators and historians note that anti-Semitism and white supremacy rear their ugly heads even today, capturing the films bookend images of rallies in Charlottesville, Virginia in 2017 and Atlanta, Georgia in 2018. HITLERS MEIN KAMPF: PRELUDE TO THE HOLOCAUST not only explores the question of how something like this could have happened, but also reveals the ways in which National Socialism could rise again today.

programme.title: D-Day: Over Normandy
programme.desc: This innovative WWII documentary uses drone footage over key D-Day locations in France, along with newly created maps and photo animations, to visualize the D-Day landings in a new way. The modern-day aerial footage is accompanied by interviews with World War II veterans who bravely fought in those locations. Narrated by legendary American football coach Bill Belichik.

programme.title: A Ripple of Hope
programme.desc: On April 4th, 1968, civil rights leader Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. was shot and killed in Memphis, Tennessee. As news of his assassination spread, American cities were engulfed in chaos and fear. Urban areas erupted in riots and fires burned out of control. Dozens of people were killed. Meanwhile, presidential candidate Robert F. Kennedy was in Indianapolis, where he was scheduled to make a campaign appearance in an African-American neighborhood. Kennedy wanted to deliver the news to the people. But local police warned him, they won't be able to provide protection if the people rioted. Kennedy wrote out some brief notes and then courageously gave a moving plea for peace and reconciliation on the back of a truck. It would eventually be regarded as one of the great political speeches of the twentieth century.With digitally restored news footage and original music by Grammy Award winning composer John Colby, A RIPPLE OF HOPE draws on interviews with Kennedy aides and associates, as well as everyday people who were in the crowd that night, to tell the story of an inspiring moment in American history.
